name: Arjun Rajkumar
message:
Our beautiful Golu this year must remain one of our most reminisced. 

I love how we were receptive to new ideas for displays and for recruiting pieces from my personal collection.

Our goody bags were fun to pack and remain beautiful in the houses of those who attended our Golu.

As the icing on the cake, I love how cooperative we were when setting everything up and for the efficient, optimizing ways we combined cultural atmosphere with fun, everyday toys.

Much to the amazement of the Aunties and Uncles who came and saw our Golu, we can validate that this Golu is one of the best ones yet🥳
